Software Engineer Intern, Platform (Summer 2027)
Larkspur Freight is hiring a backend intern to work on the systems that plan 40,000 deliveries a day.

What you'll do
- Build and run Python services that talk to our routing and mapping providers
- Make slow PostgreSQL queries fast and keep them fast
- Ship REST APIs used by our driver and dispatcher apps

Minimum qualifications
- Experience with Python and SQL
- PostgreSQL or another relational database
- Docker and Git
- REST API design

Preferred qualifications
- TypeScript or Node.js
- Kubernetes
- AWS
- Redis
